about_the_game:
Speed Braind - Blind Quiz AI is THE game that will put your speed and general knowledge to the test! 🎯 Challenge your friends and dive into a world where movies, series, cartoons, and modified music will no longer hold any secrets for you. The AI offers you increasingly exciting challenges with every game!

🚀 Why download Speed Blind - Blind Quiz AI?

🔥 An endless challenge: Guess excerpts from movies, series, and cartoons, or recognize modified songs! Yes, the songs are real, but they've been altered—it’s up to you to find their title and artist! 🎶

🎮 Fun multiplayer mode: Face off against your friends in intense duels and claim the top spot!

🆕 New challenges with every update: The AI constantly generates new puzzles to spice up your experience.

⚡ Fast and addictive gameplay: Every second counts! Who will be the quickest to find the right answer?

🎬🎵 A game for all tastes: Whether you’re a movie buff, a series addict, or a music lover, there’s something for everyone!

🔥 Join the competition, train your brain, and become the quiz master with Speed Blind - Blind Quiz AI! Every guess is a victory, and every game is a new challenge.

💥 Ready to take on the challenge? Download the app now and put your brain to the test!
